reason: My money has sat in NRO for years and I keep saying I'll sort it on the next trip. My cousin in India can chase the bank for nothing, so paying a stranger online isn't where I'd start.
objection: I haven't even logged into SBI in months, and I'd have to hand over bank details and property-sale papers to a company I've never heard of, when family could do it for free.
would_change_my_mind: A relative or my SBI branch telling me it's a nightmare to do myself, or a friend who used them and got a lump sum across smoothly.
